The club will play in the [[Challenger Pro League]] following their loss against [[Lommel SK]] in the relegation play-offs. The club is named after former clubs [[K.F.C. Denderleeuw Eendracht Hekelgem|KFC Denderleeuw Eendracht Hekelgem]] and '''Verbroedering Denderhoutem''', which merged at the end of the [[2004–05 in Belgian football|2004–05 season]], and after the river [[Dender]], which crosses the town of Denderleeuw. The home stadium of the club is [[Florent Beeckmanstadion]], located in Denderleeuw. Their best league ranking was 12th place in the [[Belgian Pro League|first division]] (in [[2024–25 Belgian Pro League|2024–25]]). The club colours are blue, red, white and black."}}
